An underscore with ASCII punctuation on BOTH sides is left- and right-flanking and satisfies both of CommonMark's escape clauses, so it can open AND close. That is a third class of exposure, neither leading nor trailing: {{ .ProjectName }}{{ .Os }}{{ .Arch }} emphasises, and so do p//q//r and -- -- and |||.

A single token can also carry a leading run and a trailing run at once, so it needs no partner elsewhere: init and all are emphasised where governed_by and schema_version are not.

The cover is the ordinary one. A code span defuses the whole run: {{ .ProjectName }}_{{ .Os }}_{{ .Arch }}. So does a backslash escape: __init__.
